questions.question: How should the PR #1128 finding (the CodeQL filter drops more than its docs say) be handled?

options.label: Verify, then decide (Recommended)
options.description: I read codeql.yml and check whether CodeQL's results file includes the flagged source text. Then I report back whether the finding holds and whether the `...` fix can work, before anything changes.

options.label: Run /fix-pr now
options.description: Treat the review comment as correct and let /fix-pr fix it, reply and resolve the thread. Faster, but builds on a fix that hasn't been checked.

options.label: Leave it for now
options.description: No action. The comment stays open on the PR for you or whoever works on #1128/#1127 to handle.
